_comment: The quality floor for the QC gate. A candidate script that loses a pairwise comparison against this is not published. Deliberately competent-but-unremarkable: specific enough to be a real bit, flat enough that anything genuinely funny should beat it. Raising this raises the bar for every future video.

beats.text: My flatmate labels his food in the fridge.
Not with his name. With dates. Every container has a little date on masking tape.
Last week I moved one two inches to get the milk.
He noticed. He asked me, genuinely, whether I had a system.
He looked at me like I'd told him I couldn't read.
